author: KEXP
description: Dutch band Iguana Death Cult returns to KEXP with their fourth studio album 'Guns Out.' Their in-studio session delivers punchy garage rock and propulsive post-punk, sharing a performance of the record's title track and more.
title: Iguana Death Cult performs "Guns Out" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
